title: Judge Gift Cards 2014: card flavor text

entities.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
entities.description: A ghostly chieftain who speaks of having been uncrowned by death and returning as king of a greater realm.

entities.name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
entities.description: A ship's navigator who calls herself a maker, not a destroyer, though she has spent her life fighting.

entities.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
entities.description: A lich king who suffered a brutal death and an unnatural rebirth; his enemies wonder whether it was his plan all along.

events.summary: Karador declares that death tried to uncrown him, but he has returned as king of a greater realm.
events.quote: Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm.

events.summary: Hanna reflects that she never expected to spend her life fighting, seeing herself as a maker rather than a destroyer.
events.quote: I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer.

events.summary: Nekusar, the lich king, suffered a brutal death and unnatural rebirth, leaving his enemies wondering whether he had planned it all along.
events.quote: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.
